# fw_ai MCP tool

> Query Fw AI Brain (FTS5), Soul constitution, Router providers, or Low-Level LTO/AOT matrix. Input schema, parameters and a tools/call example for the fw_ai…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/mcp/fw-ai/

Query Fw AI Brain (FTS5), Soul constitution, Router providers, or Low-Level LTO/AOT matrix.

## Call it

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "fw_ai",
    "arguments": {
      "action": "brain_index"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `string: brain_index, brain_search, soul, router, lowlevel_matrix, dedupe` | yes |  |
| `query` | `string` | no |  |
| `model` | `string` | no |  |

## Input schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "brain_index",
        "brain_search",
        "soul",

        "lowlevel_matrix",
        "dedupe"
      ]
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "model": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [

  ]

```
